headline: 2026 Performance Misses Target, Danantara Becomes Victim of IHSG Plunge
summary: PT Danantara Investment Management said its 2026 performance did not reach its target, citing the impact of volatility in Indonesia's capital market.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, so its returns and investment performance matter for state-linked assets and local equity sentiment.
original_headline: Kinerja 2026 Tak Capai Target, Danantara Jadi Korban Anjloknya IHSG
